title: Record site knowledge
description: Record what this task learned about how the page's site works, for the next run: up to 10 entries of kind control, reading, pitfall or state. Controls are named by targetId; DSphere takes their label and role from its own view. Text that looks like the person's data is refused.
guidance:
Requires an idempotency key.

Before answering, record once what this task learned: key controls (targetId, purpose), the reading method and its fields, pitfalls and page states. Write how the site works, never data: no record values, names, numbers, accounts or task wording; those, and controls inside a data record, are refused. entries: a plain list, at most 10; text over maxLength is cut (shortened).

inputSchema.description: The page the entries were learned on, and the entries.

pageContextId.description: The page from dsagent.page.open or dsagent.pages.list, or a closed one a finish siteKnowledgeAsk named; the site is the page's own, never named by the caller.

expectedRevision.description: The revision the target ids belong to; required when an entry names a target.

items.description: One entry. control: targetId, purpose, optional needs and signedInOnly. reading: method and fields, optional pagination, lazyScroll, region, note. pitfall: type, note, optional targetId. state: name, optional signs (target ids) and leaveBy.

targetId.description: An id a reply gave you. control: the control (required); pitfall: the control it concerns. A control inside a data record (a result row or card) is refused.

purpose.description: control: what the control does, such as "sort results by sales".

needs.description: control: what must happen first, such as "open the sort menu".

signedInOnly.description: control: true when the control shows only while signed in.

method.description: reading: the method that read the data.

items.description: A field name, never a value.

fields.description: reading (required): the fields this read produced.

lazyScroll.description: reading: true when records render only once scrolled into view.

region.description: reading: the page region holding the records, such as "search results".

note.description: pitfall (required) or reading: what happens and what to do, in a sentence.

name.description: state: its name, such as "search results".

items.description: A target id a reply gave you at expectedRevision.

signs.description: state: target ids of controls that show the page is in this state.

site.description: The site the entries were kept under.

results.description: One result per entry, by index.

outcome.description: added: a new entry; merged: it updated the same entry (same control, method, pitfall or state); rejected: nothing saved.

reason.description: Why it was rejected: it looks like the person's data; the target is part of a data record; the target is not in the page's last observation; the target is not a control; the store is full.
